task_description: Create a Document Management System using Python FastAPI. Supports document upload to groups/folders, preprocessing (deskew, enhance, denoise), conversion to Markdown/CSV/Images, encrypted PDF storage, LLM summarization and keyword extraction, vector DB indexing for RAG search, RAG chat interface, and an LLM Wiki system that incrementally builds a structured knowledge base from ingested documents.
